program_name: Bachelor of Arts in Journalism and Digital Communication

programme_facts.value: Real-world practical and critical thinking skills for journalism informed by a balanced sense of justice, accuracy and life-experience.

value: Produce their own radio reports and TV bulletins in state of the art studios.
Work on the award winning Limerick Voice news website, social media platforms and local newspaper (www.limerickvoice.com).
Produce and design an online magazine.
Work with the latest digital publishing and editing software programmes including Adobe Audition, Final Cut Pro and Indesign.
Use social media to self-publish and promote work.
Learn key fact-checking and online verification skills.

programme_facts.value: The journalism assignments are geared towards being published with a news outlet.
Aislinn was able to build her portfolio as she progressed with her studies.
